review_questions: Independently verify that the Slice 6 terminal-authority gate satisfies the frozen contract without deriving release, deploy, merge, production, or completion authority from model/worker/reviewer claims or green CI.
Verify exact binding of project_id, task_id, effect_id, terminal action, target artifact SHA, authoritative state version, review evidence, and authority expiry/current-time inputs.
Verify malformed, stale, expired, mismatched, unsupported, or model/worker-supplied authority records fail closed and cannot mint a terminal-action authorization receipt.
Verify successful authorization is deterministic, self-hash bound, and remains authorization-only: this slice must not execute merge/release/deploy/production/completion side effects.
Verify replay/substitution attempts across action, artifact SHA, state version, task/effect identity, or evidence refs are rejected or produce non-equivalent receipts rather than widening authority.
Verify the 24-case Slice 6 suite and candidate-bound CI are evidence of implementation execution only and do not become semantic or terminal authority.
Adversarially inspect for any path that would let terminal authority be inferred from stale conversation state, worker/model assertions, prior green runs, or unbound external evidence.
Return an independent disposition without relying on the proposer conclusion or the PR description.

required_review_dimensions.description: Terminal authority remains external to model, worker, researcher, judge, CI, and isolated-execution success.
Authorization binds exact project/task/effect/action/artifact SHA/state version/review evidence and cannot widen across substitutions.
Stale, future-invalid, expired, malformed, or mismatched authority records fail closed.
Required review evidence and review state are independently checked and cannot be bypassed by terminal authority claims.
Authorized receipts are deterministic, self-hash bound, and mutation of bound fields invalidates or changes the receipt.
The slice performs no merge/release/deploy/production/completion side effect and makes no broader execution claim.
CI evidence is exact-candidate execution evidence only and does not become semantic or terminal authority.
Replay or substitution of action, artifact, state version, identity, or evidence cannot mint widened terminal authority.
Slice 1→5 accepted authority boundaries remain preserved by the candidate.
Adversarial review finds no remaining false-green, stale-state, conversation-memory, or claimant-controlled terminal-authority bypass within the frozen scope.
